outcome: An invited person opens their link and sets up their account
acceptance_criteria: `/staff/join/` renders with no `/me` call and no top bar or phone bar. — verify: unit (render `AppShell` at `/staff/join/` with a fetch spy: only `GET /api/v1/session` and the preview POST); mock (no "My work" link).

After the page reads the fragment, the address bar is `/staff/join/` with no `#`, and the token appears in no URL, storage (`localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `document.cookie`) or console output; it is sent only in the JSON body of preview and accept. — verify: unit (spy on `history.replaceState`, storage and `console`; assert request URLs and bodies); mock (Playwright reads `page.url()` and storage after load).
No fragment, a fragment of the wrong length, or one with other characters shows the unavailable state and sends no preview request. — verify: unit.
The page's response sets `Referrer-Policy`/`<meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer">`. — verify: mock (page source or `document.querySelector('meta[name=referrer]')`).
After the fragment is cleared, a reload shows the unavailable state. — verify: mock (Playwright reload).

A valid link shows "Set up your account", "Welcome, Sola Martins. You've been given PMO for Ojo Foods and Kora Logistics.", the validity line with the date from `expires_at`, a read-only "Work email" with the preview email, "New password", "Confirm new password" and "Finish setup". With the two-group fixture the text reads "You've been given PMO for Ojo Foods. You've also been given Finance Lead for Kora Logistics." — verify: unit (both fixtures) and mock.

Desktop and phone layouts match `SCR-17-desktop-setup` and `SCR-17-mobile-setup` apart from the exceptions in "Conflicts with the boards". The page shows no "At least 12 characters", no "72 hours" or other duration, no WhatsApp field or code sentence, and no `review_alerts` control. — verify: mock (design fidelity run at 1440 and 390 wide; `grep -rn "12 characters\|72 hours\|WhatsApp" frontend/src/features/join` returns nothing).

Expired, used and wrong-token fixtures (`'e'`, `'u'`) show the identical unavailable text and link; the text never contains "expired" as a statement of fact. — verify: unit (snapshot equal for both) and mock.
The `name`, `access` and workspace values are rendered as text: a fixture name containing `x` shows the literal characters. — verify: unit.

Preview with 429, 503, 500 or a thrown network error shows "We couldn't open your invitation. Nothing was changed." with "Try again" and no form; Try again recovers. — verify: unit and mock (scenario cookies).
Empty password, empty confirm and mismatch show the three messages from the table, make no accept request, and focus the right field. — verify: unit.

The accept body is exactly `{token, password, confirm}` (no `review_alerts`) with `X-CSRFToken` from the last session read, and `method="post"` on the form means a submitted form never changes the address bar. — verify: unit (assert body keys and header) and mock (press Enter, address stays `/staff/join/`).

Each failure in the accept table shows exactly the specified outcome, both password fields cleared, the email kept: 422 `invalid_input` with `fields` (messages under fields); 422 without fields; 422 `action_unavailable` "This password is too short…" (callout with the server text; preview recheck still valid, form stays); the renewed-token fixture (`'r'`) lands in the unavailable state; 403 `csrf_failed` (retry works with the new token and no reload); 429; 500/503; network error (extra "try signing in" sentence). — verify: unit with one fixture per row; mock for 429/503/500 scenario cookies.

Success on the mock: a good password pair gives "Your account is ready." with "Sign in with sola.martins@psl.example." and a "Sign in" link to exactly `/sign-in` (the retired `next_url` is not followed). Opening the same token again shows the unavailable state. — verify: unit and mock (`e2e/join.spec.ts`).

If the session read after accept says `signed_in: true`, the page runs the onboarding path: `admitted:false` shows the F-58 not-admitted message with working "Sign out"; `admitted:true` goes to the safe `next_url` or `/`; a `next_url` of `https://evil.example` or `/accounts/login/` is never followed. — verify: unit (router spy).

`SignInView` is unchanged in behaviour after the extraction: the existing `tests/sign-in.test.tsx`, `tests/sign-in-next.test.ts` and `e2e/sign-in.spec.ts` pass without edits. — verify: `npm test` and the e2e spec.
Preview of a fresh local invitation returns the real name, email, `expires_at` and workspaces and the page shows them as returned. — verify: live (browser at `/staff/join/#<token>`, network log).

A password shorter than 12 characters is refused by the server and the page shows the server's message under the callout without any number typed in the page's own code; a mismatch is stopped by the page. — verify: live; `grep -n "12" frontend/src/features/join` shows no password rule.

A good accept returns 201, the page shows the ready state, the account exists (`manage.py shell`: user with the invitation's username), and signing in on `/sign-in` with the email and the new password lands on the person's first destination, with the top bar showing the invited person's name and the role words from `GET /role-dashboard`. — verify: live (screenshot of the bar; network log shows `/me` and `/role-dashboard` after sign-in).

Used, expired and superseded tokens (accept once then reuse; set `expires_at` in the past in the local database; issue a resend with `preceding_id`) all show the identical unavailable page; `curl` of preview for each returns `422 invitation_unavailable` with the same body. — verify: live.

Wrong tenant and wrong user: a token for one invitation never reveals another invitation's data; a 43-character random token returns the same 422 body as an expired one; the preview and accept requests with a missing or wrong `X-CSRFToken` return 403 `csrf_failed` and change nothing (the invitation can still be accepted afterwards). — verify: live (`curl` through the proxy).
Race: two tabs accept the same token with a good password; one gets the ready state, the other the unavailable state (or the callout then unavailable), and exactly one account exists. — verify: live.

Axe finds no violations on `/staff/join/` in the ready, field-error, page-error, unavailable and ready-done states, desktop and phone; keyboard: Tab order email (skipped as read-only is acceptable only if it is focusable), New password, Confirm, Finish setup; the problem callout takes focus on a failed submit. — verify: mock (Playwright with `expectNoAxeViolations`, as in `e2e/frame.spec.ts`).
`grep -rn "staff/join" frontend/next.config.ts` is empty (no proxy to Django), and `tests/next-config.test.ts` still passes. — verify: grep and `npm test`.

The mock routes validate against the live contract (200, 201, 422 `invitation_unavailable`, 422 `invalid_input`, 403 `csrf_failed`) and reject a non-current token. — verify: unit (extend the `tests/mock-live-me.test.ts` pattern).

risk.rationale: RISK is high. The page sets a password from a bearer token in a URL fragment, which is an identity and account-creation path (D-SIGNIN r2, D-AUTH r3, contracts/psl-factory.openapi.json 1.22.0). SURFACES are ui, api, security and auth. I left out contract-change because F-58 already changed the shared pieces, and this feature only adds a page. I left out product-decision because the unknown policy numbers and the WhatsApp step are bound out of scope above.

findings.summary: A failed session read after a successful accept is reported as a failed set-up. Expected: once accept has returned 201, the page says the account was created (the ready state, "Sign in with <email>."), because the account exists whatever the session read says (AGENTS.md: reconcile uncertain effects; spec "After set-up"). Actual: `refreshSession()` at `frontend/src/features/join/JoinView.tsx:129` sits inside the same `try` as the accept, so its error goes to the accept-failure `catch`. A 5xx then shows "Set-up isn't working right now. Try again in a moment. Nothing was changed.", and a network error shows the connection message, both with the form still showing. `token.current` was already set to `''` at line 125, so pressing Finish setup again sends `token: ''`. That comes back as 422 `invalid_input` on `token`, and the callout shows the field message with no way forward except the small sign-in link. Fix: catch the post-accept session read separately and treat a failure as `signed_in: false`, which shows the ready state. Add a unit case (accept 201, session GET 500 or network) that expects the ready state.

The validity line does not use the existing frame date formatting. Expected: spec "Validity line" says to use "the existing Lagos-time date formatting used by the frame". For screens whose board draws no date, that is `formatDateTime` in `frontend/src/components/format.ts` (D-93): "26 Nov 2026 · 15:00 WAT". Actual: a new `Intl.DateTimeFormat` copy, `lagosWhen`, at `frontend/src/features/join/welcome.ts:16-22` prints "26 Nov 2026, 15:00" with no time zone. This duplicates the shared helper and leaves the time ambiguous for someone outside Lagos. Fix: use `formatDateTime(preview.expires_at)`, keep hiding the line when the result is `UNKNOWN`, and update `tests/join.test.tsx:137` and `e2e/join.spec.ts:40`.

`open()` at `frontend/src/features/join/JoinView.tsx:71-72` sorts errors by kind, without knowing whether the session read or the preview failed. So a 4xx on `GET /api/v1/session` (for example a 400 or a non-csrf 403 from a proxy) shows "This invitation can't be used" rather than the spec's "session read failing: cannot open" callout with Try again. This is unlikely in practice. Splitting the session read into its own `try` would fix it.

Phone brand band missing. Board SCR-17-mobile-setup draws a full-width #1F2427 band (390x51) holding "PSL FACTORY" at the top; the built page at 390 shows the wordmark on the light background with no band (report.json: "background #1F2427 on the board, none on the page"). Visual 55.6 vs required 90. Expected: dark band as the board. Actual: no band. Path: frontend/src/features/sign-in/BrandColumn.tsx (and join.css / sign-in phone styles). Check against the F-58 sign-in phone board before changing the shared component so sign-in does not regress.

Desktop brand column carries three illustrations and the tagline "Work you can see moving, from first draft to verified."; the SCR-17-desktop-setup board shows only the wordmark on an empty dark column. The other SCR-17 boards (sign-in, error) do carry the tagline, and the column is the shared F-58 component, so this is treated as settled. Design engineer to confirm or add an exception.

Work email renders as a grey read-only field (tinted fill, no heavy border); the board draws it as a white bordered input like the others. Reasonable for read-only, but it is a visible difference. Design engineer to confirm.
